column1: # 3GPP TS 38.413 NGAP PDUs that other implementations sent, captured on the wire in
# local lab runs on 2026-10-12 (tcpdump of SCTP in the network namespace of each core,
# which ran from its release sources). Each distinct PDU of a sender is here once:
#     free5gc/nas v1.1.3 and free5gc/ngap v1.0.8, as gNB
# The procedures are registrations with sessions, deregistrations, service requests, N2
# and Xn handovers, and what a core answers to deliberately wrong messages. The
# subscribers are test values, 208-93 0000000001 to 0000000008 with the key of the sample
# configuration of PacketRusher: nothing here is of a real subscriber.
# The procedure code and the PDU alternative are read from the first two octets. The
# last column is what tshark 4.6.4 says the frame is, from which the first column has
# the name of the message, and `-` where tshark names none.
